title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves reasoning in language models, but scalar outcomes provide coarse supervision over response trajectories. Self-distillation offers denser token-level guidance by comparing an unassisted policy with a feedback-informed self-teacher, yet the teacher evolves with the student, creating unstable targets and motivating additional regularization. We introduce Function-Space Policy Optimization (FSPO), a single-policy framework that combines current privileged adaptation with function-space temporal consolidation. FSPO stores sparse historical next-token distributions as fixed temporal targets, providing temporal separation without maintaining a persistent teacher model. It further introduces privileged disagreement correction to explicitly suppress locally overvalued actions, reliability-adaptive grounding that strengthens reference supervision when self-generated evidence repeated

translated_title: 面向策略优化的函数空间时间自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但标量结果只能为响应轨迹提供粗略的监督信号。自蒸馏通过将无辅助的策略与基于反馈信息的自教师进行比较，能够提供更密集的词元级指导；然而教师会随学生一同演化，导致监督目标不稳定，因而需要额外的正则化。我们提出了函数空间策略优化（FSPO），这是一个单策略框架，将当前的特权适应与函数空间时间整合相结合。FSPO将稀疏的历史下一词元分布存储为固定的时间目标，在无需维护持久教师模型的情况下实现时间上的分离。该框架进一步引入特权分歧校正以显式抑制局部被高估的动作，并引入可靠性自适应锚定，在自生成证据重复时强化参考监督（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出单策略的函数空间策略优化框架FSPO，以稀疏的历史下一词元分布作为固定时间目标进行自蒸馏，无需维护持久教师模型即可提供稳定密集的词元级监督，并通过特权分歧校正与可靠性自适应锚定提升策略优化效果。
en_tdlr: FSPO is a single-policy framework that self-distills from sparse historical next-token distributions stored as fixed temporal targets, delivering stable and dense token-level supervision without maintaining a persistent teacher model, while privileged disagreement correction and reliability-adaptive grounding further improve policy optimization.
